project.name: Llandudno Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Local Cadw and National Monuments Record of Wales data and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 56 directly adjoining public green-space geometries and 3 reviewed visitor extensions were included in the active visitor boundary.

touristAppeal.label: Destination draw
touristAppeal.summary: Llandudno has destination-scale depth led by Great Orme Visitor Centre, Great Orme Tramway, Great Orme Bronze Age Mines and Llandudno - Alice's Wonderland, with enough independent visitor experiences for most of a day.

townGuide.headline: Llandudno: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Llandudno offers Great Orme Visitor Centre, Great Orme Tramway, Great Orme Bronze Age Mines within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Great Orme Visitor Centre
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Great Orme Visitor Centre and Great Orme Tramway, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
